T0580.title: APK Signing
T0580.definition: The signing process that lets Android verify the publisher and integrity of an application package.
T0580.description: APK signing proves the publisher and integrity of an Android application package and underpins installation, upgrade, and distribution trust. Leaked signing keys, weak signing strategy, or repackaging bypass can let malicious versions impersonate the official app. Controls focus on key protection, signature-scheme upgrades, channel verification, and rotation planning.
T0580.usageExample: Assess APK Signing related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
